items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Yeah, Piku was a teacher over there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Piku was a teacher over there. And there were two teachers, Piku and, uh, uh, uh, this guy's name is Morellis. Well, Morellis was teaching me. Yeah. See, I didn't, Piku was teaching the night class. Yeah. And I was going to day class.
